senses.gloss: (v. P. Sm. 1691 s. v. כוז), [to shrink,] to be shy, bashful. Part. כָּזִיז.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 72b">Pes. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ מינה</he> Ar. a. Ms. O. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, ed. <he>בזיז</he>) he is reserved towards her (not yet intimate).

<cite ref="Yevamot 26a:13">Yeb. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>דכ׳ בניה מיניה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>דב׳</he>) before him his son is shy. Ib. 112ᵃ top <he>מִיכְזַז כ׳ מינה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מיב׳ ב׳</he>), opp. <cite ref="C00772"><he>גיס</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="C00773"><he>גִּיס</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Niddah 15b:8">Nidd. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>ילדה דכְזִיזָא למיטבל</he> (ed. <he>דב׳</he>) a young woman who is ashamed to go to the bath-house.
